rows.status: Substituted by HB04970

committee_action.meethigh: The Committee heard the position of the Department of Finance, Bureau of Internal Revenue and National Tax Research Center who strongly objected to the proposed measures because of revenue loss estimated from P10.3B to P43.6B. However all the other guests representing teachers and labor groups and House Members present endorsed the different proposals as the ceiling was never adjusted to reflect the effects of inflation for almost 17 years despite the delegated mandate given to the Secretary of Finance to adjust the ceiling of the 13th month pay/Christmas bonus and other benefits in the computation of the exclusion from gross income. The Committee approved the creation of the technical working group to consolidate the bills.

rows.status: Substituted by HB04970

committee_action.meethigh: The Committee heard the position of the Department of Finance, Bureau of Internal Revenue and National Tax Research Center who strongly objected to the proposed measures because of revenue loss estimated from P10.3B to P43.6B. However all the other guests representing teachers and labor groups and House Members present endorsed the different proposals as the ceiling was never adjusted to reflect the effects of inflation for almost 17 years despite the delegated mandate given to the Secretary of Finance to adjust the ceiling of the 13th month pay/Christmas bonus and other benefits in the computation of the exclusion from gross income. The Committee approved the creation of the technical working group to consolidate the bills.
